key_concepts: In undisturbed rock sequences, the oldest layer is at the bottom
Younger sedimentary layers are deposited on top of older layers
Cross-cutting features such as intrusions and faults are younger than the rocks they cut
Unconformities represent gaps in the rock record
Nonconformity, angular unconformity, and disconformity are types of unconformities
Faulting can offset matching rock layers on either side
Erosion can remove rock layers from a sequence
Half-life is the time needed for half of a radioactive sample to decay
Carbon-14 dating is used to date organic remains such as wood, bones, mummies, and the Ice
The Italian Iceman is about 5,300 years old based on carbon-14 analysis
After five half-lives, only 3.125 percent of the original radioactive parent remains
After 17,190 years, 10.0 g of carbon-14 would decay to 1.25 g
